answer: Faking identities costs real capital, since a gale of duplicate accounts must each post a full bond before earning any trust. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers randomly audit a small sample each epoch. At dawn, validators release slashed bonds from failed audits to honest peers, while a fresh zephyr of new agents starts with zero weight until audited. This makes mass fake identities economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0112's threat model.
